claims: Eid al-Fitr 2026 marks the conclusion of Ramadan.
Eid al-Fitr 2026 celebrations fall on Friday, March 20, 2026, in Saudi Arabia.
Eid al-Fitr 2026 celebrations fall on Friday, March 20, 2026, in the UAE.
Eid al-Fitr 2026 celebrations fall on Friday, March 20, 2026, in many other parts of the world.
Eid al-Fitr 2026 celebrations in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and many other parts of the world are based on the crescent moon sighting.
Some regions, such as India, may celebrate Eid al-Fitr 2026 on Saturday, March 21, 2026.
A common tradition of Eid al-Fitr is offering Salat al-Eid in the morning.
A common tradition of Eid al-Fitr is sharing meals and desserts, especially sheer khurma or sweets.
A common tradition of Eid al-Fitr is exchanging gifts, greetings, and spending time with loved ones.
